summary: Pre-market brief. The composite risk score stands at 45.65, up 0.09 on the day, with the risk level still caution and the regime still goldilocks; fact-layer confidence is 0.9241. The macro block remains the heaviest dimension at 62.19 and sits at cycle extremes: the 10-year real rate is 2.46 at the 99.6th percentile, the 10-year nominal is 4.83 at the 99.28th percentile with a risk score of 98.56, and the 10Y/2Y spread is 0.40 against an effective fed funds rate of 3.63. The last US session was a broad de-rating of AI hardware: AI infrastructure fell 3.7326, data centers 3.1808 and semiconductor equipment 3.1115, with MU down 4.8999 and AMD down 3.3583. Asia handed the pre-market a weaker hand: all 11 tracked A-share names closed lower, led by 000021.SZ at -4.0274. The dominant catalyst is the US Consumer Price Index release at 2026-09-11T12:30Z, the only high-importance event in the seven-day window. With the real rate already at the 99.6th percentile there is little tolerance for an upside inflation surprise, yet credit at HY OAS 2.71 and VIX at 16.46 still price calm rather than stress. Pre-market bias: defensive into the print, with the missing confirmation being a credit-spread break rather than a volatility spike.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The macro block is the heaviest dimension at 62.19 and sits at cycle extremes: the 10-year real rate is 2.46 at the 99.6th percentile, the 10-year nominal is 4.83 at the 99.28th percentile with a risk score of 98.56, and the 10Y/2Y spread is 0.40 against an effective fed funds rate of 3.63, so long-end restraint is the binding constraint on the score.

The last US session de-rated AI hardware across the board: AI infrastructure fell 3.7326, data centers 3.1808, semiconductor equipment 3.1115, semis -2.9016 and memory -2.8721, with MU down 4.8999, AMD down 3.3583 and NVDA down 2.374.

The US Consumer Price Index release at 2026-09-11T12:30Z is the dominant near-term catalyst, the only high-importance event in the seven-day window, and the news flow treats it as decisive for the upcoming policy decision.

Equity internals are thin: new highs are 0.0065 of the market with a risk score of 88.7, new lows 0.0645, breadth above the 200-day only 0.5613, and small caps at -2.4631 and semis at -8.9131 on a relative basis, so leadership is narrow going into the print.

The CN AI complex handed the pre-market a weak hand: all 11 tracked A-share names closed lower, led by 000021.SZ at -4.0274, 001309.SZ at -3.7038 and 300475.SZ at -3.1932, so the hardware leadership that drives US risk is being sold in Asia.

supporting_signals.claim: The score increase is macro-led: the total score rose 0.09 to 45.65, up 1.84 on the week and 2.57 on the month, with the macro block at 62.19 and the 10-year real rate at 2.46 holding the 99.6th percentile, so the drift is driven by the level of real rates rather than by market stress.

The volatility block is the lowest of the six at 24.69, so the market's main stress valve is unused: VIX at 16.46 and realized vol at 8.5365 mean there is no cushion of fear to absorb a negative inflation surprise.
Liquidity plumbing is tight at the margin: the reverse repo balance at 4.736 sits at the 14.61st percentile and the Fed balance sheet is 6740619.0, a thin buffer as the front end is repriced.

contradicting_signals.claim: Credit is not confirming: HY OAS is 2.71 at the 12.83rd percentile and IG OAS 0.81 at the 37.28th percentile, so spreads stay tight - the classic non-confirmation of an equity-led scare.
Trend remains constructive: the price is 6.1821 above the 200-day, the 52-week drawdown is only -2.5775 and 3-month momentum is 4.4663.

The last session was rotation rather than exit: digital advertising rose 1.2198, consumer electronics 0.2512 and fintech 0.0915, while AI software only fell 0.2925, so leadership moved inside tech instead of leaving it.
The dollar is the one macro input far from a cycle extreme at 118.0732, the 15.49th percentile, so the pressure is concentrated in real rates rather than in broad financial conditions.

what_changed_today: The total risk score rose 0.09 to 45.65, a third straight daily increase, with the regime unchanged at goldilocks.
The macro block printed 62.19 with the 10-year real rate at 2.46 (99.6th percentile) and the 10-year nominal at 4.83 (99.28th percentile).
AI hardware led the last US session lower: AI infrastructure -3.7326, data centers -3.1808 and semiconductor equipment -3.1115, with MU -4.8999 and AMD -3.3583.
All 11 tracked A-share names closed lower, with 000021.SZ the weakest at -4.0274.
NYMEX gasoline fell more than 2% to 3.32 dollars per gallon, while the dollar index eased to 118.0732, the 15.49th percentile.
watch_next: The US CPI release at 2026-09-11T12:30Z: a hot print against a real rate already at the 99.6th percentile is the highest-conviction tail risk in the window.
Whether credit confirms: HY OAS at 2.71 has not widened, and a move above it is the signal that would validate the equity de-rating.
Advance Retail Sales on 2026-09-16T12:30Z for demand-side confirmation after a 162.0 payroll print.
Whether the 10Y/2Y spread at 0.40 steepens or flattens as the long end reprices policy restraint.
Earnings from FDX on 2026-09-17 with a forecast of 4.21 and COST on 2026-09-24 with a forecast of 6.55, the first hard read on volumes and the consumer.

bull_case.title: Bull case: CPI undershoots and the long end retreats
points: A soft CPI print lets the 10-year real rate ease from 2.46 at the 99.6th percentile, releasing the macro block at 62.19 and pulling the total score back below 45.65.
Credit at HY OAS 2.71 and VIX at 16.46 already price calm, so a benign print would be confirmed by the tape, and rotation into digital advertising at 1.2198 and fintech at 0.0915 can broaden.

base_case.title: Base case: an in-line CPI leaves the macro block in control
points: An in-line print leaves the policy path unresolved, so the macro block at 62.19 stays the dominant weight and the score holds near 45.65.
Sector-level rotation continues rather than a broad exit: AI software at -0.2925 and fintech at 0.0915 against AI infrastructure at -3.7326, with HY OAS 2.71 and VIX 16.46 capping the downside.

bear_case.title: Bear case: a hot CPI into a 99.6th-percentile real rate
points: A hot print pushes the 10-year nominal above 4.83 and reprices the policy path toward a hike against an effective fed funds rate of 3.63, with the real rate at 2.46 offering no cushion.

With new highs at 0.0065 and breadth at 0.5613, the AI complex is the path of least resistance lower: AI infrastructure at -3.7326, data centers at -3.1808 and memory at -2.8721, with BTC at 77005.0 as the risk-appetite tell.
